reviews.title: Great physical debugging LED on the board
reviews.comment:
I used this to assemble a new computer, and at first the computer didn't boot up (wouldn't POST). On the physical motherboard itself are a bunch of LEDs for CPU, RAM, etc. It immediately told me the problem was with the CPU. I took out the CPU, reseated it, and the system booted up flawlessly.
The motherboard debugging LEDs saved me a ton of time.
